title: Behaviours: what derails withdrawals
objectives: Answer five client behaviours with the manual's “what to say” line.
Use the one line for any withdrawal conversation.
body_md:
Behaviours that derail withdrawals.

| Behaviour | What it sounds like | What to say |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Overspending early | “We've earned it; let's do the big trips now.” | “Let's set aside a travel pot, so the monthly plan stays safe.” |
| Panic in a fall | “Move everything to FDs before it falls further.” | “Your next two years are already in safe funds. Equity has years to recover.” |
| All-FD comfort | “I only trust fixed deposits now.” | “FDs alone may not keep up with 6% inflation for 25 years. Let's keep a growth bucket.” |
| Fear of spending | “I won't touch the corpus at all.” | “The plan is built to be spent. Here's what you can safely draw.” |
| Supporting family | “My son needs ₹15 L for his business.” | “Let's see what that does to your withdrawal rate before deciding.” |

The one line to remember: spend from safety, grow from equity, and refill on a plan.
example: “Move everything to FDs before it falls further.” → “Your next two years are already in safe funds. Equity has years to recover.”
say: Spend from safety, grow from equity, and refill on a plan.
FDs alone may not keep up with 6% inflation for 25 years.
never: Move everything to FDs in a fall.
Never touch the corpus at all.

check.q: A new retiree's equity bucket fell 18% and he wants to move all to FDs. What do you do?
o: Move everything to FDs at once
Show Buckets 1–2 cover the next years; avoid selling equity low; apply guardrails; no market predictions
check.why: Show Buckets 1–2 cover the next years; avoid selling equity low; apply guardrails; no market predictions.

check.q: “I only trust fixed deposits now” is best answered:
o: “FDs alone may not keep up with 6% inflation for 25 years. Let's keep a growth bucket.”
check.why: All-FD comfort: “I only trust fixed deposits now.” Say: “FDs alone may not keep up with 6% inflation for 25 years. Let's keep a growth bucket.”

check.q: “My son needs ₹15 L for his business” is best answered:
o: “Let's see what that does to your withdrawal rate before deciding.”
check.why: Supporting family: “My son needs ₹15 L for his business.” Say: “Let's see what that does to your withdrawal rate before deciding.”
